This event occurred on 2014/03/02 at 20:11:23 UTC at the geographic coordinates 27.431°N 127.367°E and a depth of 119.0km (magnitude, location and time from the USGS National Earthquake Information Center).

Further information regarding possible flight paths indicated that a time of arrival at AIS of approximately 00:26:30 might be possible.
